title: World Timezones
subtitle: Global chronology, solar illumination, and standard international time offsets.

zones.name: GMT -12:00
zones.label: UTC-12:00 (Baker Island)
zones.description: The westernmost timezone on Earth. Uninhabited US minor islands that are the last places to enter a new calendar day.

zones.name: GMT -11:00
zones.label: UTC-11:00 (Samoa / Niue)
zones.description: Covers American Samoa and Niue in the South Pacific Ocean.

zones.name: GMT -10:00
zones.label: UTC-10:00 (Hawaii / Tahiti)
zones.description: Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time and Tahiti. Does not observe Daylight Saving Time in Hawaii.

zones.name: GMT -09:00
zones.label: UTC-09:00 (Alaska)
zones.description: Alaska Standard Time, covering nearly the entire state of Alaska except the westernmost Aleutian islands.

zones.name: GMT -08:00
zones.label: UTC-08:00 (Pacific Time)
zones.description: Pacific Standard Time (PST), home to Silicon Valley, the US Pacific coast, and British Columbia.

zones.name: GMT -07:00
zones.label: UTC-07:00 (Mountain Time)
zones.description: Mountain Standard Time (MST). Arizona remains on UTC-7 year-round without Daylight Saving Time.

zones.name: GMT -06:00
zones.label: UTC-06:00 (Central Time)
zones.description: Central Standard Time (CST), stretching from Canada through the US Midwest and Texas down into Central America.

zones.name: GMT -05:00
zones.label: UTC-05:00 (Eastern Time)
zones.description: Eastern Standard Time (EST), covering Wall Street, US capital, and western South America (Colombia, Peru, Ecuador).

zones.name: GMT -04:00
zones.label: UTC-04:00 (Atlantic / Caribbean)
zones.description: Atlantic Standard Time and parts of South America (Venezuela, Bolivia, Chile in winter).

zones.name: GMT -03:30
zones.label: UTC-03:30 (Newfoundland)
zones.description: Newfoundland Time Zone, a distinctive half-hour offset in eastern Canada.

zones.name: GMT -03:00
zones.label: UTC-03:00 (Brasília / Buenos Aires)
zones.description: Brasília Time and Argentina Time. Dominates south-eastern South America and Greenland's main settlements.

zones.name: GMT -02:00
zones.label: UTC-02:00 (Mid-Atlantic)
zones.description: Mid-Atlantic islands including Brazil's Fernando de Noronha archipelago and South Georgia.

zones.name: GMT -01:00
zones.label: UTC-01:00 (Cape Verde / Azores)
zones.description: Cape Verde and Portugal's Azores archipelago (standard time).

zones.name: GMT 00:00
zones.label: UTC±00:00 (Greenwich / London)
zones.description: Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) and Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) reference meridian. Spans the UK, Portugal, Iceland, and West Africa.

zones.name: GMT +01:00
zones.label: UTC+01:00 (Central European Time)
zones.description: Central European Time (CET) and West Africa Time. One of the most populous and economically active timezones.

zones.name: GMT +02:00
zones.label: UTC+02:00 (Eastern European / Cairo)
zones.description: Eastern European Time (EET), Central Africa Time, and South African Standard Time.

zones.name: GMT +03:00
zones.label: UTC+03:00 (Moscow / Arabia / East Africa)
zones.description: Moscow Time, Arabia Standard Time, and East Africa Time. Year-round fixed UTC+3 in Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Moscow.

zones.name: GMT +03:30
zones.label: UTC+03:30 (Iran)
zones.description: Iran Standard Time (IRST). Iran abolished DST in 2022, staying permanently on UTC+3:30.

zones.name: GMT +04:00
zones.label: UTC+04:00 (Gulf / Caucasus)
zones.description: Gulf Standard Time and Caucasus nations (Azerbaijan, Georgia, Armenia).

zones.name: GMT +04:30
zones.label: UTC+04:30 (Afghanistan)
zones.description: Afghanistan Standard Time (AFT), half-hour offset across the Hindu Kush.

zones.name: GMT +05:00
zones.label: UTC+05:00 (Pakistan / Central Asia)
zones.description: Pakistan Standard Time, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Maldives, and western Siberia.

zones.name: GMT +05:30
zones.label: UTC+05:30 (India / Sri Lanka)
zones.description: Indian Standard Time (IST), serving over 1.4 billion people across the entire Indian subcontinent with a single half-hour offset.

zones.name: GMT +05:45
zones.label: UTC+05:45 (Nepal)
zones.description: Nepal Standard Time, one of only three 45-minute timezone offsets in the world, based on the meridian of Mount Gauri Sankar.

zones.name: GMT +06:00
zones.label: UTC+06:00 (Bangladesh / Omsk)
zones.description: Bangladesh Standard Time, Bhutan, and eastern Kazakhstan.

zones.name: GMT +06:30
zones.label: UTC+06:30 (Myanmar / Cocos)
zones.description: Myanmar Standard Time (MMT) and Australia's Cocos (Keeling) Islands.

zones.name: GMT +07:00
zones.label: UTC+07:00 (Indochina / Western Indonesia)
zones.description: Indochina Time (ICT) and Western Indonesia Time (WIB).

zones.name: GMT +08:00
zones.label: UTC+08:00 (China / Singapore / WA)
zones.description: China Standard Time (covering all 5 geographical solar zones under Beijing time), Singapore, Malaysia, Philippines, and Western Australia.

zones.name: GMT +08:45
zones.label: UTC+08:45 (Eucla, Australia)
zones.description: Central Western Standard Time (CWST), an unofficial 45-minute offset used along the Eyre Highway in Western Australia.

zones.name: GMT +09:00
zones.label: UTC+09:00 (Japan / Korea)
zones.description: Japan Standard Time (JST) and Korea Standard Time (KST). Does not observe Daylight Saving Time.

zones.name: GMT +09:30
zones.label: UTC+09:30 (Central Australia)
zones.description: Australian Central Standard Time (ACST), covering South Australia and Northern Territory.

zones.name: GMT +10:00
zones.label: UTC+10:00 (Eastern Australia / Vladivostok)
zones.description: Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST), eastern Russia, and Guam.

zones.name: GMT +10:30
zones.label: UTC+10:30 (Lord Howe Island)
zones.description: Lord Howe Standard Time. Uniquely advances by only 30 minutes for Daylight Saving Time (to UTC+11:00).

zones.name: GMT +11:00
zones.label: UTC+11:00 (Solomon Islands / New Caledonia)
zones.description: Southwest Pacific nations (New Caledonia, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu) and Magadan in eastern Russia.

zones.name: GMT +12:00
zones.label: UTC+12:00 (New Zealand / Fiji)
zones.description: New Zealand Standard Time, Fiji, and Kamchatka peninsula. Among the earliest places to celebrate each new day.

zones.name: GMT +12:45
zones.label: UTC+12:45 (Chatham Islands)
zones.description: Chatham Islands Standard Time, New Zealand's unique 45-minute offset archipelago.

zones.name: GMT +13:00
zones.label: UTC+13:00 (Tonga / Samoa / Phoenix)
zones.description: Tonga, Samoa (which crossed the International Date Line in 2011 to align with Australia/NZ trade), and Kiribati's Phoenix Islands.

zones.name: GMT +14:00
zones.label: UTC+14:00 (Line Islands, Kiribati)
zones.description: The easternmost timezone on Earth. The very first place on Earth to greet each calendar day and celebrate New Year.
